recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, high-key outdoor portrait of a male subject on a sandy beach, featuring a large-scale, thin-weight sans-serif title and a smaller, wide-tracked subtitle. The composition balances the subject on the right with negative space and typography on the left, anchored by weathered driftwood in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed away from the camera toward the horizon
Typography color sampled from the sky and natural shadows
Foreground driftwood providing textural contrast to the subject's smooth clothing
High-key lighting washing out the background to emphasize the subject and text
coreInvariants: Left-aligned text block in the upper-left quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the right third of the frame, shown from the waist up, occupying approximately 40% of the horizontal space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large-scale title text act as dual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze to the left toward the typography, then down to the driftwood in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open sky and beach area on the left side to accommodate text without clutter.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and sand tones (background and clothing)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted sky blue and warm tan (typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with very high value; colors are airy and light-filled.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to natural earth and sky tones

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on clean, modern geometric forms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and tracking contrast; thin/tight display paired with regular/wide subtitle.

preserve: Thin stroke weight of main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean geometric structure and thin stroke required for the display text.
A widely available alternative with similar geometric proportions.
Classic geometric sans-serif that matches the airy, modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, bright outdoor photograph of a man in a white long-sleeve shirt standing on a sandy beach. Include weathered driftwood in the lower left foreground. The background should show a pale blue sky and a distant shoreline with soft waves. The man should be on the right side of the frame, looking away from the camera. The lighting should be bright and slightly overexposed to create a clean, airy feel.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, thin-weight geometric sans-serif text in the upper left, colored in a muted sky blue. Below that, add a single line of smaller, regular-weight sans-serif text with very wide letter spacing, colored in a warm tan tone. Align all text to the left.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-key and bright?
Is the main title text thin and large?
Is the subtitle text widely tracked?
Is the subject positioned on the right third?
Is the color palette limited to coastal tones?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of sky blue for typography
mustRedesign: Do not replicate existing brand logos
Ensure text content is generic or user-provided
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not overlap the subject's face
Ensure the driftwood provides a clear foreground anchor
Verify the high-key lighting doesn't lose all detail in the white shirt
Confirm the typography tracking is consistent with the recipe
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key coastal portrait with asymmetrical, thin-weight geometric typography for a modern, airy music aesthetic.
